prompt: You want to stretch for two minutes every day but keep forgetting. Which setup makes best use of a routine you already have?

options.text: Do the stretches straight after brushing your teeth at night, with the mat already by the bathroom door
Stretch whenever you happen to remember during the day
Replace it with one 30-minute stretch once a week
Set six random phone alarms a day as reminders

explanation: Attaching the new habit to an existing one — brushing your teeth — gives it a reliable daily cue, and having the mat ready removes the small friction that often stops a start.
